name: aidlc-management-tool
description: Read-only analysis of an AI-DLC v2 run: what needs you, how far along it is, where the evidence sits, and what the engine actually did.
author: Le Bao Duy
highlights: Every gate, question, guard stop and stalled turn in one queue, with the evidence beside it
Execution truth read from runtime-graph, not re-derived from the audit
Stage inspector with artifacts, sensors, reviewer verdicts and revisions
Sources page that names every input the engine read, and every one it could not
Read-only: the workspace is never written to
useCases: See what an AI-DLC v2 run is waiting on you for, with the evidence beside it
Check whether a stage's artifacts are actually complete before approving a gate
Read a reviewer verdict and its findings without leaving the workspace
configuration: Choose the AI-DLC v2 workspace inside the app; reads are read-only
